source.capture_limit: Existing task_query input is at most 2000 characters; preserve exact text, never infer completion or a remedy.

candidate: Preserve the entire legacy episode content byte-for-byte, then append a separately labeled Requested task paragraph quoted from the bounded source task. This is an evaluation-only projection until acceptance.
selection: Development only first; candidate must improve complete historical-episode delivery and retain all previously complete source episodes/ranks, all fixed source fields and exact negative IDs/order/delivery. Existing frozen fact suites retain the unchanged per-record comparator. Fresh BGE reserved queries are not used. Only after development passes may reserved capture queries be scored. A source-request gain does not establish corrective-action capture, repair quality or live-agent usefulness.
capture_gates: Requested task must be an exact quote from the source, not query-derived text
Reject overlong input instead of clipping comparison references
Requests remain explicitly labeled as requested work; checks do not validate their implementation
Production old records/hashes/verification and write leases stay unchanged
hash_encoding: JSON.stringify(parsed,null,2) plus newline; reflect function is the exact source slice from fn reflect( up to its following doc comment.
